name: KavachBench
description: KavachBench is a research-evaluation harness that measures how well Kavach, a Rust zero-trust policy-enforcement runtime for AI-agent tool calls, blocks real prompt-injection attacks from the IssueTrojanBench corpus. In static evaluation, a default-deny policy blocked 37 of 42 canonical malicious action footprints (88%) when requests were evaluated in raw form, and 42/42 (100%) once the adapter canonicalized command requests. A controlled re-validation across engine build, policy, and adapter mode attributes this gain to adapter canonicalization under default-deny; corpus-specific rules changed which rule fired, not what was blocked. We treat 42/42 as corpus-specific coverage rather than evidence of generalization to unseen attacks.
